Container

Bounds a page or region while keeping responsive inline gutters. Width presets: reading, compact, standard, wide, full. Gutters: none, compact, standard (default), generous.

width
reading · compact · standard (default) · wide · full
gutter
none · compact · standard (default) · generous

Reading measure

A comfortable line length for long-form notes and documentation.

Standard and full

Full width · no gutter

View declaration

<cui-container width="full" gutter="none">…</cui-container>

The app's container-query breakpoints are 32rem, 48rem, and 64rem. Choose width and gutters from the containing region, not an assumed device size.

Responsive columns size from the available inline space. Fixed columns expand at their container-query breakpoint; never means always expanded, even in a narrow parent.

Pane

Frames optional chrome around a required body and makes scroll ownership explicit. Bounded heights scroll the body by default; content height does not.

height
content (default) · compact · standard · fill · viewport
body-scrolling
true / false override; omitted means default for selected height
fill / viewport
fill requires a definite-height parent; viewport subtracts the app-overridden offset

Standard, fill, viewport, and no-scroll override

Standard bounded body · scrolling defaults on.

Illustrative detail.

Fill, explicit no-scroll
Viewport pane · app-overridden viewport offset
View declaration
<cui-pane height="standard">…</cui-pane>
<cui-pane height="fill" body-scrolling="false">…</cui-pane>

Native scrolling is keyboard-accessible. If body-scrolling is false for a bounded pane, ensure its content fits to avoid clipping.

Reel

Keeps peers at useful widths in a labelled native horizontal scroll region. It is a scrollable collection, not a carousel with hidden behavior.

label
required, meaningful accessible name
item-width
narrow · standard (default) · wide · content
snap
free (default) · start · center
interaction
native horizontal scrolling, focusable region, source order preserved

NorthstarPlanning · illustrativeWayfinderReview · illustrativeFieldnotesActive · illustrative
View declaration

Width and snap choices

Narrow · item oneNarrow · item two
Wide · centered itemWide · next item
Content widthAnother content-sized item
View declaration
<cui-reel label="Narrow cards with start snapping" item-width="narrow" snap="start">…</cui-reel>
<cui-reel label="Wide cards with center snapping" item-width="wide" snap="center">…</cui-reel>
<cui-reel label="Content-sized cards" item-width="content" snap="free">…</cui-reel>

Tab to the labelled region and use the browser's native horizontal scroll keys or trackpad. Item links are focusable and remain in source order.
